jobs.title: Staff Data Analyst
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Founded in 2018, Quince was built to challenge the idea that nice things have to cost a lot. Our mission is simple: to make really high quality essentials for really low prices, produced fairly and sustainably. We believe everyone deserves exceptional craftsmanship and timeless design without the traditional markups. Quince is a direct-to-consumer (DTC) model that cuts out middlemen and leverages just-in-time manufacturing to minimize waste and maximize value.

Quince is a tech company disrupting the retail industry by putting AI, analytics and automation at the center of everything we do. Our unwavering commitment to excellence and company values guide our teams and actions:

Customer First: We prioritize customer satisfaction in every decision.
High Quality: True quality means premium materials and rigorous production standards you can feel good about.
Essential Design: We focus on timeless, functional essentials instead of chasing trends.
Always a Better Deal: Innovation and transparency ensure value for both customers and partners.
Social & Environmental Responsibility: We commit to sustainable materials, ethical production, and fair wages.

Quince partners with world-class manufacturers across the globe and serves millions of customers. With strong investor backing and a focus on sustainable growth, we are a company that is rapidly scaling while maintaining a commitment to quality, simplicity, and radical price transparency.

OUR TEAM AND SUCCESS

At Quince, you will be part of a high-performing team that is redefining what quality, value, and sustainability mean in modern retail. We are a destination for builders, innovators, and operators to come together and challenge the status quo. Our collective ambition is bold. We are creating an entirely new category and customer experience – one that democratizes luxury and provides high quality products at radically low prices. That mission demands a world-class team committed to excellence.

If you are motivated by impact, growth, and purpose, you will find a strong sense of belonging at Quince.

Staff Data Analyst

Our Story

Quince was founded to challenge the idea that exceptional quality must come with an exceptional price tag. Our mission is simple: create products that match or exceed the quality of leading luxury brands and offer them at radically lower prices.

Our Values

Everyone Should Be Able to Afford Nice Things

Quality shouldn't be a luxury. We are committed to making the world's highest-quality products accessible at affordable prices.

Quality Is More Than Materials

True quality comes from both premium materials and exceptional craftsmanship.

We Focus on the Essentials

From the perfect cashmere sweater to hotel-quality bedding, we create thoughtfully designed essentials that elevate everyday life.

We're Innovating to Make Unreal Prices a Reality

Our factory-direct model eliminates unnecessary markups, allowing us to deliver exceptional products at unmatched value.

Always a Better Deal

We believe in radical price transparency for both our customers and manufacturing partners, creating better outcomes for everyone.

Fair Factories

We partner with factories that meet rigorous global standards for workplace safety, ethical practices, and wage fairness.

Our Team

Quince is a retail and technology company founded by leaders with deep experience across retail, technology, and high-growth startups. You'll work alongside exceptional talent from organizations including Stanford GSB, Wish, D.E. Shaw, Stitch Fix, Urban Outfitters, Wayfair, McKinsey, Nike, and many others.

The Opportunity

Quince is seeking a talented and highly analytical individual to join our Growth organization. In this role, you will own measurement and analytics across our growth marketing channels, helping the team make faster, smarter, and more effective investment decisions.

You will develop and maintain attribution frameworks, incrementality testing programs, and performance measurement systems to understand what drives customer acquisition and where marketing dollars generate the greatest return. Over time, you will become a trusted expert on growth performance across the Quince platform, partnering closely with marketing leadership to surface insights, run experiments, and build scalable analytics capabilities that support the company's rapid growth.

The Ideal Candidate

You are a highly analytical problem solver who is excited about using data, technology, and experimentation to drive business growth. You thrive in fast-paced environments where ambiguity is common and answers are not always readily available.

You are energized by ownership, move quickly without sacrificing rigor, and enjoy working in a culture that values data-driven decision-making, intellectual curiosity, and high standards. You are comfortable collaborating across functions and influencing stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

Responsibilities

Own marketing attribution and measurement frameworks across growth channels, including paid search, paid social, affiliate, and other acquisition programs
Design, execute, and analyze incrementality tests and experimentation programs to measure causal marketing impact
Build and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly performance reporting for growth marketing and company leadership
Develop automated monitoring systems to ensure data quality, reporting accuracy, and timely insights
Create scalable analytics tools and processes that accelerate decision-making across the Growth team
Partner closely with marketing leadership to translate data into actionable channel, audience, and budget recommendations
Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify growth opportunities, diagnose performance changes, and uncover key business drivers
Apply statistical and predictive modeling techniques to improve marketing efficiency and performance
Support advanced measurement initiatives, including marketing mix modeling (MMM), attribution modeling, and forecasting
Partner cross-functionally with Data, Product, Engineering, and Finance teams to improve measurement infrastructure and business understanding
Preferred: Support app measurement and mobile attribution initiatives

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or a related discipline
5–7 years of experience in analytics, data science, or quantitative business roles, preferably focused on growth marketing, ecommerce, or performance marketing
Hands-on experience building attribution models and designing incrementality or experimental measurement frameworks
Demonstrated ability to independently scope, execute, and communicate complex analyses that drive measurable business impact
Advanced SQL skills and strong proficiency in Python for data analysis, modeling, and automation
Familiarity with major advertising platforms and measurement ecosystems, including Meta, Google, TikTok, and similar channels
Experience applying statistical methods and predictive modeling to business problems; experience with marketing mix modeling is a plus
Strong understanding of experimentation design, causal inference, and marketing measurement best practices
Experience leveraging AI-powered tools to improve productivity, analysis, and insight generation
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across technical and non-technical audiences
Ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple high-impact initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
Strong sense of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and commitment to delivering exceptional results

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range: $207,000 USD - $235,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

Position Overview

Davey Resource Group, a Davey Company, has opportunities for an experienced Environmental Scientist/ Restoration Specialist. Davey Resource Group is a leader in the natural resource and forestry consulting industries throughout the US.

Job Duties

The Environmental Specialist will provide our government, utility, commercial, private and not-for-profit clients with the services and solutions needed to efficiently and effectively manage natural resources and comply with policies.

Selected candidates will work collaboratively as part of a team. Applicants should be willing to lead and train fellow team members on all aspects of field work. Communicate with clients professionally. Position involves a variety of work, including invasive plant species control, native plant and seed installation, shoreline stabilization, and native habitat restoration (prairie, wetland and woodland).

The majority of work is outdoors, often in inclement weather and in rugged terrain, and may involve using heavy equipment, such as spray rigs, backpack sprayers, augers, chain saws, mowers, etc. Additional work in assisting with wetland delineation and city tree inventories may be required at times.

Work with the project manager to understand the contract needs and specifications of clients and their customers and develop appropriate solutions.
Inspect a wide range of habitats, both natural and disturbed, and assess their condition, health and functionality according to client specifications.
Identify local species, understand their typical characteristics and recognize common diseases and pests.
Train and mentor teammates.

Qualifications

Education and Qualifications:

An individual must be able to perform each essential job duty consistently and satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Possession of an Minnesota Department of Agriculture Certified Pesticide Applicators License is required.
Prescribed burn experience and S130/S190 certification.
Identify invasive species across a range of habitats.
Training with chain saw, brush saw, and 4x4 ATV/UTV, tractor, and skid steer.
A degree in biology, botany, ecology, conservation, environmental science, or related fields.
Three to five years of experience in ecological restoration.
Driver’s license and clean driving record are required.
Ability and willingness to travel.

Desired Qualifications:

Natural resource consulting experience preferred.
Experience with operating heavy equipment, forestry mower, tractor, etc. preferred.
Ability to read construction plans and specifications to execute tasks and assign work to crew members preferred.
CDL Class A Driver preferred.
Experience leading crews of 1-4 people.

40-50 hours per week, Monday-Friday with some Saturdays optional.

Employee-owned company and discounted stock purchase options.
Group Health Plan.

Locations throughout the United States in major cities and desirable areas.
Career Development Program supported by industry expert safety specialists and skilled trainers.

All listed benefits available to eligible employees.

, Inc., headquartered in Kent, Ohio has opportunities for persons interested in the field of urban forestry. We are seeking teamwork-oriented individuals with excellent written and oral communication skills. Candidates should possess a professional work ethic with attention to detail and safety. MMGE - HEREDITARY GENOMICS DIV (IN-HGN-IUINA)

One of the first human genetics departments in the country, the Department of Medical and Molecular Genetics at Indiana University (IU) School of Medicine has a rich history of training geneticists and genetic counselors and providing genetic consultation and counseling services. Currently ranked 5th in the nation among Genetics Departments for National Institutes of Health (NIH) Funding, received in 2023, the department contributes to the understanding of numerous genetic conditions through the integration of basic research in genetic and genomic mechanisms, translational research in disease models, and clinical trials in rare and common genetic diseases.

Department-Specific Responsibilities

Develop, test, maintain, and troubleshoot software solutions and research data workflows using Python and SQL.
Design, optimize, and support database queries, data integrations, and related processes for NIH-funded and privately funded research studies.
Collaborate with investigators, research staff, and technical stakeholders to translate study requirements into secure, reliable, and maintainable technical solutions.
Develop and support data pipelines, workflow automation, and analytics or reporting platforms.
Help maintain the integrity, quality, security, and appropriate handling of research data.
Document technical designs, data processes, software changes, and operational support procedures.
Assist with troubleshooting and resolving software, database, and data-processing issues throughout the research lifecycle.

General Responsibilities

Provide experienced analysis of existing data and data structures and satisfies ad-hoc reporting/analysis requests.
Create reporting specifications for new reports/dashboards/analytical tools and perform testing/validation; ensures integrity, accessibility, and accuracy of reports/dashboards and data structures; review and approve user requests for access to reporting data and tools.
Consult with faculty and/or staff to identify new business reporting needs and provide guidance and interpretation of complex environments and data.
Document data analysis efforts (data sources, reporting specifications, tools, issue/problem resolutions).
Perform experienced analysis to interpret and determine validity and quality of data.
Perform migration and conversion of data as needed in support of analysis efforts.
Research and stay up-to-date on emerging technologies and tools and make recommendations for implementation to improve data analysis services and approaches.

Combinations of related education and experience may be considered. Education beyond the minimum required may be substituted for work experience. Work experience beyond the minimum required may be substituted for education.

Required

Required

Preferred

Experience supporting research, healthcare, scientific, or other data-intensive environments.
Experience with data integration, ETL/ELT processes, data quality practices, or automated data workflows.
Experience working with sensitive or regulated data and following applicable security, privacy, and data-governance requirements.

Required

Proficient communication skills.
Maintains a high degree of professionalism.
Demonstrates time management and priority setting skills.
Demonstrates a high commitment to quality.
Possesses flexibility to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment.
Seeks to acquire knowledge in area of specialty.
Highly thorough and dependable.
Demonstrates a high level of accuracy, even under pressure.

Preferred

Maintains a high level of self-direction by seeking out opportunities to add value, rapidly learning what is needed, and taking ownership for results.

jobs.title: Product Data Analyst
jobs.description:
IMPORTANT: Please be aware, scammers may try to impersonate Zello by reaching out regarding job opportunities. We will never ask you for bank account information, checks, or other sensitive information as part of our hiring process. All correspondence will come from the zello.com email domain. If you’re unsure, please email recruiting@zello.com with questions.

About Zello

Zello is a voice-first communication platform, powered by our industry-leading push-to-talk technology, to improve collaboration and productivity for desk-less workers. With over 175+ million users, we’re the #1 rated push-to-talk app in the world, delivering 9 billion (yes, with a B) messages a month.

At Zello, our company values are at the heart of what we do everyday. We’re proud to serve the frontline, we’re privileged to connect people in times of crisis across the globe, and we’re honored to support first responders.

And this is where you come in.

We're hiring a Product Data Analyst to help us figure out where the product goes next. Zello is push-to-talk for frontline workers - millions of people use it to do their jobs every day - and we want someone who can turn what we see in the data into clear calls about what to build. You'd join the Data & AI team here in Austin.

This one's hands-on and heavily AI-leveraged. You'll dig into the data, form hypotheses, spec the telemetry for our web and mobile apps, run the experiments, and call what ships and what doesn't. You'll lean on AI agents to handle the routine work so your time goes to the thinking that actually moves things.

After a successful first year, you will have

Run 10+ well-powered product experiments end to end, from hypothesis and telemetry spec through analysis to a clear ship-or-kill call, with real impact on activation or conversion.

Build and run AI-agent workflows that take the grunt work off your plate, and check what they hand back.

Who you are

You've owned A/B tests end to end and can point to decisions that changed because of your work, not just dashboards you built.
You write advanced SQL on your own against a cloud warehouse, and you reach for Python when it helps.

You pick the right method for the data in front of you instead of running the same test every time.
